page.overview:
Who is Anchiornis?

(meaning "near bird") is an extinct genus of paravian theropod dinosaur that lived in China during the Late Jurassic period around 160 million years ago. Like the Microraptor, it has four feathered wings. It also had a greyish body color with red head feather crests and white wings with black tips. Its face was mottled with reddish and black spots.

Darius Bowman mentioned Anchiornis as the possible new dinosaur that Jurassic World had announced while visiting his father Fredrick in a hospital.

While trying to figure out what a mysterious feathered dinosaur could be, Ben Pincus and Gia speculate that it could be a Yutyrannus, a Sinornithosaurus, or an Anchiornis, none of which are known to have been created by anyone as of yet.

Anchiornis is mentioned in the database entry for the Tiaojishan Formation: the dig site for Jeholopterus.
